Players Committee card image of [[Qui-Gon Jinn, Serene Jedi]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Once per game, may deploy Meditation on Qui-Gon from Lost Pile. If alone during battle: your total battle destiny is +1 for each weapon destiny draw that was completed while alone this battle, and opponent may not cancel your destiny draws. Immune to attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.
